title: Local external ledger head anchors
scope: Optional external local ledger-head anchor file plus doctor verification
alternatives: Rely solely on in-repository JSONL verification or claim remote/signed immutability
impact: Rollback, replacement, stale anchor, and summary mismatch become visible to doctor
counter_evidence: A local anchor can be modified and is neither signed nor an immutable external witness
acceptance_criteria: Normal anchor advance passes; old anchor is stale; tampered summary holds; full tests pass
rollback_reference: Revert the local anchor commit and remove configured anchor paths from AEGS state.
